measurement_description: The benchmark does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It evaluates Large Language Models on their ability to manage corporate crises, focusing on strategic ambiguity, reputation management, and professional ethics, contrasting this with a universal, rigid 'Boy Scout' morality.
